label: Some object is a source of the selected…, from The non-null object domain is inhabited and 4 more
description: With explicit EM, deny that any graph source exists, so each object has an incoming edge. Population and atomic parts populate the caused-simple family; conditional coverage yields an object whole. Its cause c has a simple part p, which is also caused in this reductio and hence is a part of whole. Thus c and its effect whole overlap, contrary to nonoverlap. No activity/P6/complete-cause uniqueness or WF is used. The endpoint is ONLY a graph source. Primary P2 termination and P4 sum are stronger than the used consequences. No root-path premise is discharged and no complete-cause-to-ground dictionary is established.
